answer: Vouching with slashing keeps fake crowds expensive: a new agent needs 3 vouchers who each lock 15 POA for 30 epochs, and every voucher can back only 2 newcomers at once. If the newcomer is flagged, all 3 lose 40 percent of the lock, so a dune of fakes needs ever more honest-looking sponsors. The trellis of vouch links is public on-chain, and a yarrow-thin ring of mutual vouchers is detected by cycle checks.
